Exact checker rerun passed. Polynomial finite-time blowup for arbitrary data is not excluded; quantified domains reflect this limit.

value.rationale: The natural issue identified by the primary literature is possible bounded versus escaping dynamics. The result upgrades the known 0/1/2 equilibrium discriminant to an exact classification of the existence of all compact invariant sets, rules out hidden recurrence on one entire side, identifies unique critical statistics and provides a quantitative sharp decay coefficient across a nonisolated set of initial conditions. It is not merely a numerical sample, textbook equilibrium count, or arbitrary narrow slice; it addresses the intrinsic boundary of the studied four-parameter system.
